image:image.image:title: Reinforcement Learning - Q-Learning, DQN, PPO, AlphaZero Visualizations
image:image.image:caption: RL algorithms visualized as value surfaces, policy manifolds, and decision boundaries

image:image.image:title: Q-Learning Value Surface - State-Action Values
image:image.image:caption: Mathematical: Q(s,a) = Q(s,a) + alpha * (r + gamma * max_a' Q(s',a') - Q(s,a)). Temporal difference update.

image:image.image:title: Bellman Optimality Surface - Dynamic Programming
image:image.image:caption: Mathematical: V*(s) = max_a sum_{s'} P(s'|s,a) * [R(s,a,s') + gamma * V*(s')]. Bellman optimality equation.

image:image.image:title: DQN Experience Replay - Memory Buffer Visualization
image:image.image:caption: Mathematical: L(theta) = E[(r + gamma * max_a' Q(s',a';theta^-) - Q(s,a;theta))^2]. Target network loss.

image:image.image:title: Policy Gradient Landscape - REINFORCE Algorithm
image:image.image:caption: Mathematical: nabla_theta J(theta) = E[nabla_theta log pi(a|s;theta) * R]. Policy gradient theorem.

image:image.image:title: PPO Clipped Objective - Proximal Policy Optimization
image:image.image:caption: Mathematical: L^CLIP(theta) = E[min(r_t(theta)*A_t, clip(r_t(theta), 1-epsilon, 1+epsilon)*A_t)]. Trust region update.

image:image.image:title: Actor-Critic Dual Surface - Policy and Value Networks
image:image.image:caption: Mathematical: Actor: pi(a|s;theta), Critic: V(s;w). Advantage: A(s,a) = Q(s,a) - V(s). Two-network architecture.

image:image.image:title: MCTS Search Tree - Monte Carlo Tree Search
image:image.image:caption: Mathematical: UCB1 = Q(s,a)/N(s,a) + c * sqrt(ln(N(s))/N(s,a)). Upper confidence bound for trees.

image:image.image:title: AlphaZero Dual Head - Policy and Value Network
image:image.image:caption: Mathematical: (p,v) = f_theta(s), L = (z-v)^2 - pi^T*log(p) + c*||theta||^2. Self-play training objective.
